description: Poll Temporal for terminal workflow status and fire a Dagster job + optional AssetMaterialization/Observation.

workflow_id.label: Workflow ID
workflow_id.description: Specific Temporal Workflow ID. Set this OR list_filter.

list_filter.label: List Filter
list_filter.description: Temporal Visibility List filter. Sensor picks the most-recently-closed match.

job_name.description: Dagster job to trigger on terminal success.
job_name.label: Job Name

asset_key.label: Asset Key
asset_key.description: Optional Dagster asset key to materialize / observe on terminal success.

asset_event_type.description: 'materialization' (default) or 'observation'. Use 'observation' when paired with temporal_workflow_trigger to avoid double-counting materializations.
asset_event_type.label: Asset Event Type

api_key_env_var.description: Env var with Temporal Cloud API key.
api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var

tls_cert_env_var.description: mTLS client cert env var (pair with tls_key_env_var).
tls_cert_env_var.label: Tls Cert Env Var

tls_key_env_var.description: mTLS client private key env var.
tls_key_env_var.label: Tls Key Env Var

tls_server_root_ca_env_var.description: Env var with a PEM-encoded custom root CA.
tls_server_root_ca_env_var.label: Tls Server Root Ca Env Var
